m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Oh dear. Be careful. You might not want to come in here. This Bullhemoth is not very nice. No, not very nice at all.
It's cold in here, so very cold. I asked politely, but this Bullhemoth won't let me leave.  I wouldn't want that to happen to you.
Oh goodness. That was scary, so very scary. But you were so brave! Yes. Thank you for defeating that big, mean Bullhemoth.
We're going to Walruskberg. I hear there are a lot of Pingouins there. It's exciting, isn't it? I can't wait. Nope. Can't wait.
That reminds me! Did you see the Duchess? Oh? She went to the Rangers' Camp up the road? That's good, very good.
I don't know why, but I always seem to wind up getting bullied by someone. It's sad, so very sad.
I should hurry and catch up with the Duchess. She's probably getting impatient, so very impatient. I'll see you at the camp!
Of all the nightmares! The Rangers tell me there's been some kind of uprising in Walruskberg! My cousin's been placed under house arrest!
Foolish Antuskette! I warned her! You can't trust these Pingouins. Can you imagine the humiliation she must be suffering?
Eww. We certainly can't visit Walruskberg now. We'll just have to return to Walzakistan. Be a dear and tell Lilly to get my luggage ready.
Going back to Walzakistan? Oh dear. We'd have to pass through Urville Station again. There's something bad there, very bad indeed.
Hold on. Did Ivan hear correctly? There is trouble at Urville Station? Ivan has... friends there. He does not like to hear this.
I'm sure your friends are all right, Ivan. Well, I hope so. Maybe it will be like Walruskberg! Is it true the Pingouins have taken over?
I can hardly believe it. Oh, I would very much like to visit, but... I'd have to leave the Duchess. How would I support myself? Oh dear.
Oh nooo! I almost forgot one of my most important accessories... my handmaiden, Chilly Lilly. The Bullies pushed her into that cave. Oooooh!
If I were home, I wouldn't bother. I mean, who doesn't have a spare handmaiden in the closet? But I simply must have her in Walruskberg.
You, dear. While this strapping Osky escorts me to camp, go see if you can do anything for little Lilly.
Watching those Bullies push little Lilly away was very traumatic for me! I'll persevere, but I must have my handmaiden. I hope you can help her.
